• Strong experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Solid experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Cloud.
• Experience with CI/CD, YAML pipelines, PowerShell and Bicep.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong technical coaching and mentoring abilities.
• Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset
 
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with:

• WCF

• GitHub EnterpriseLanguages

Our client is an international organization with a strong reputation in its sector and operations across multiple European markets. Known for its commitment to quality, responsible business practices, and continuous improvement, the company offers a collaborative and multicultural environment where people play a central role in driving success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting both employees and managers across several countries and functions.

Acting as a trusted HR partner, you will accompany teams throughout the employee lifecycle, provide day-to-day guidance on people-related topics, and help managers create engaging and high-performing work environments.

This role combines operational involvement with strategic HR initiatives. You will spend time close to the business, understanding the realities of different teams, supporting managers in their people challenges, and ensuring a consistent employee experience across the organization.

HR Partnership & Employee Support

• Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers within your assigned business areas.
• Build strong relationships with teams and maintain a close understanding of business and people challenges.
• Support managers in addressing day-to-day HR topics, employee engagement, team dynamics, and people development.
• Accompany employees throughout their journey within the company, ensuring a positive and consistent experience.
• Regularly connect with teams across different locations to stay close to operational realities.

Employee Relations & People Management

• Advise and support managers on employee relations matters, performance concerns, wellbeing topics, and workplace issues.
• Ensure people decisions are aligned with company policies and local employment regulations.
• Facilitate constructive dialogue between managers and employees when needed.
• Support disciplinary processes and sensitive employee cases with professionalism and discretion.

Talent & Performance

• Coordinate performance management and talent review processes within your scope.
• Support managers in identifying development opportunities and building individual growth plans.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at strengthening leadership and team capabilities.
• Participate in succession planning and talent development discussions.

Employee Experience & Engagement

• Support onboarding and integration activities to ensure a strong employee experience from day one.
• Contribute to engagement initiatives and help foster a collaborative and inclusive culture.
• Gather feedback from employees and managers and translate insights into practical improvements.
• Promote a culture of continuous feedback and development.

HR Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, and the implementation of new initiatives.
• Help improve HR tools, policies, and ways of working.
• Support HR reporting and analysis when required.
• Collaborate closely with other HR functions to ensure a seamless employee experience.

Experience & Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
• More than 7 years of experience as HR Business Partner within an international and fast-paced environment.
• Proven experience supporting both managers and employees across a broad range of HR topics.
• Strong exposure to employee relations, performance management, talent development, and organizational change.
• Good understanding of European employment legislation; experience across multiple countries is an asset.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility at all levels of the organization.
• Hands-on and pragmatic approach, with a genuine interest in supporting people and solving problems.
• Excellent communication and coaching skills.
• Ability to manage sensitive situations with discretion and professionalism.
• Well-organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Data-aware, with good knowledge of HR systems and reporting tools.
• Fluent in French and English; additional European languages are considered a plus.
• Collaborative, approachable, and committed to delivering an excellent employee experience.

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation-driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance. 
They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
• Knowledge of relational databases.

Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience with Aruba switches.
• Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
• Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
• Basic software development knowledge.
• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer.

• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.

However, students who show commitment, perform well, and still have sufficient student hours available will have the opportunity to work more frequently during holiday periods and continue their student job throughout the 2027-2028 academic year.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Join our team and gain valuable experience while earning extra income during your studies.

 What you'll be doing:
 

 
•  
Willing to do physical work — boxes can weigh between 10 kg and 20 kg.
 
 
•  
You should be flexible to help with all kinds of warehouse tasks, such as loading and unloading, picking, packing, labeling, receiving, and other general warehouse duties.

Since 1854, Katoen Natie has grown from a Belgian family business into a global logistics powerhouse with operations spanning five continents. Based in the strategic Gent Port, we specialize in warehousing, transport, cargo handling, and supply chain solutions for international clients. Our success stems from combining 170  years of expertise with innovative technology and a personal, SME approach to business.
Join our dynamic team where tradition meets innovation, and every day brings new challenges in the exciting world of international logistics.

Jobomschrijving

THE OPPORTUNITY
We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.
YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards
Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes
Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed
Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives
Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations
Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times
Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
Essential Requirements:

3  years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments
Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)
Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)
Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines
Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet
Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends
Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience
Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping
Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience
Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

About Our Client - Katoen Natie
We're proud to partner with Katoen Natie, a global logistics leader with over 170 years of experience operating from the strategic Gent Port. This innovative, international company specializes in warehousing, transport, and supply chain solutions, combining traditional family values with cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense corporate culture.

At Katoen Natie, colleagues who take initiative and show dedication can grow quickly within their expanding international network.

Jobomschrijving

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 
• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners
Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing
Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling
Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems
Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness
Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment
Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts
Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn
Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!
Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you
Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations
Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift
Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)
Basic Dutch or English communication skills
What Makes You Stand Out:
Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment
Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)
Previous experience in international logistics or port operations
Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace
Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specialized in storage, transport, and handling of goods. The company is located in the city of Ghent in Belgium, and the company has branches all over the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in the field of logistics and supply chain management. The company offers a wide range of services, including warehouse management, transport and distribution, packaging, quality control, and customs clearance.Katoen Natie Gent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has a strong connection with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

 

 

 

 

 

Jobomschrijving

 

We are currently looking for a motivated Terberg - Tugmaster driver (CE driver) for internal transport at Katoen Natie Gent. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out internal transport using a Terberg - Tugmaster tractor. You will be involved in moving goods and materials within our logistics environment and ensuring they are delivered to the correct locations.

 

 

• Operating the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor to move goods and materials within the facility.
• Loading and unloading trucks using the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor.
• Carefully checking goods and materials to ensure they match the corresponding documentation.
• Recording completed tasks and keeping track of inventory levels.
• Compliance with safety regulations and ensuring a safe working environment.
 

 

 

• Demonstrable experience as a Terberg - Tugmaster driver or operating similar tractors.
• You have a valid CE driver's license and code 95.
• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations regarding internal transport.
• Familiarity with safety regulations and the ability to apply them correctly.
• Good communication skills in Dutch and/or English to effectively interact with colleagues.
• You are motivated and reliable and value safety and quality.
• You are flexible regarding hours and tasks.
• Willingness to work in two shifts or nightshift
• Good physical condition and capable of performing prolonged seated work.
• Attention to detail and precise execution of tasks.
• Expirience with a forklift long vorks is a plus!

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in storage, transport and handling of goods. Based in the city of Ghent in Belgium, the company has offices around the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management. Katoen Natie Ghent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has strong ties with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

 

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.
• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.
• You speak fluent English and Dutch
• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.
• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.
• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.
• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.
• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.
